C-BROWSER-ENGINE-PROVIDER-PROCESS-202609.IntentSummary: Deliver Milestone M1.2 as one governed change: a production CEF-backed browser engine provider running through the ordinary supervised native-plugin boundary, with engine-neutral contracts, generic host process containment and bounded blob storage, crash-safe logical identity, headful S2 proving evidence, and zero browser policy in the kernel, decomposed into dependency-ordered packages P1 through P8.

T-001.Title: Author ADR-BROWSER-ENGINE-PROVIDER-PROCESS-V1 documenting CEF process topology and boundary decisions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: ADR documents native provider process topology, CEF FFI/thread boundary, subprocess dispatch before Worldline IPC, revision reservation safety, profile ownership, fail-closed security defaults, licensing, upgrade rollback limits, headful policy and OSR deferral.

T-002.Title: Add experimental v0.1 capture and primitive engine contracts and additive versioned events

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: browser.capture/v0.1, browser.engine.cookies/v0.1, browser.engine.storage/v0.1 and browser.engine.download-hook/v0.1 are defined under experimental stability with operation-level authority.
Additive events (such as page restore, readiness, specific renderer state) carry explicit payload versions without breaking existing v1.0 events.

T-003.Title: Add contract wire and API compatibility fixtures proving v1.0 preservation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Compatibility tests prove that all eight stable Browser Contract v1.0 request/response JSON wire forms deserialize identically.
BrowserError enum retains compatibility without introducing mandatory variants that break public exhaustiveness.

T-004.Title: Implement generic process-tree containment in worldline-native-host

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worldline-native-host implements ProcessTreeContainment (using Windows Job Objects with kill-on-close) established before child code can spawn descendants.
Hard-killing the parent or abnormal termination guarantees termination of all descendant child processes.

T-005.Title: Add bounded generic native blob host request protocol

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worldline-plugin-protocol adds MessageKind::BlobRequest and MessageKind::BlobResult with bounded BlobPut, BlobGet and BlobVerify payloads.
worldline-native-host implements HostRequestSink blob handling bound to current RuntimeId and attenuated handles, preserving BlobStore path confinement.

T-006.Title: Add security and containment acceptance tests in worldline-native-host

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Containment tests prove multi-process tree teardown under hard-kill and normal exit on Windows.
Blob protocol tests prove bounded chunk transfers, handle validation, and foreign handle rejection.

T-007.Title: Implement worldline-browser-provider core state machines and revision reservation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worldline-browser-provider manages BrowserContextId, PageId and DocumentRevision lifecycle with strictly monotonically increasing generation reservations via installation-state CAS before returning/publishing refs.
ElementRef is scoped to (PageId, DocumentRevision, NodeKey); stale refs and resource mismatches are rejected deterministically.
Finite budgets (QueryBounds, mailbox size, dispatch queue, deadlines) fail explicitly on saturation.

T-008.Title: Implement worldline-browser-provider-process executable with native IPC loop

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The executable speaks native IPC over stdio using worldline-plugin-protocol envelopes and handles handshake, lifecycle, capability RPC, state access and event publication.

T-009.Title: Add out-of-process provider acceptance suite with reference backend

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Supervisor launches provider process, establishes handshake, invokes all 8 v1.0 capabilities and experimental v0.1 surfaces, and validates typed event reception.

T-010.Title: Implement CEF packaging, checksum validation and safe FFI adapter

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: CEF binaries, resources and locales are validated against pinned checksums and loaded fail-closed.
CEF types, pointers and enums never cross the provider boundary into Worldline contracts.

T-011.Title: Implement CEF subprocess dispatch and thread-affine message loop

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Executable executes CEF subprocess dispatch before Worldline IPC bootstrap; CEF child roles (renderer, GPU, utility) do not open Worldline IPC or hold host handles.
CEF message loop runs on a dedicated UI thread with bounded cross-thread dispatcher; no global provider mutex is held during CEF calls.

T-012.Title: Implement native windowed headful navigation on Windows with security defaults

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Provider creates a minimal native child window and navigates local HTTP/HTTPS/about:blank fixtures.
Privileged/local schemes (file, javascript, chrome, devtools) fail closed; CEF sandbox is enabled; no ambient debugging port.

T-013.Title: Implement bounded Blink accessibility tree extraction and semantic projection

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: query_document extracts AX/DOM tree, enforces QueryBounds (nodes, depth, text bytes) with is_truncated flag, and binds actionable nodes to opaque backend-node ElementRefs.

T-014.Title: Implement safe DOM action execution targeting resolved backend nodes

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Input, click, focus, submit and scroll target exact resolved DOM nodes without JavaScript source interpolation.
Stale revision or detached node keys fail immediately with StaleElementReference or ElementNotFound.

T-015.Title: Implement experimental browser.capture v0.1 backed by host blob storage

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: browser.capture captures window/page pixels, stores bounded chunks via BlobPut, and returns provider-scoped artifact reference.
Artifact read operations require authorized capability invocation; raw BlobId grants no read access.

T-016.Title: Implement persistent context profile isolation and ephemeral incognito scavenging

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Persistent contexts use installation-owned confined roots; logical profile IDs never leak filesystem paths.
Incognito contexts use ephemeral roots that are never restored and are cleaned during recovery.

T-017.Title: Implement cookie and storage primitive capability operations

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: browser.engine.cookies/v0.1 and browser.engine.storage/v0.1 provide separate read and mutation operations partitioned by ContextId and origin.

T-018.Title: Implement fail-closed permission callbacks and download staging

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: CEF permission callbacks consult the RPC-populated decision projection synchronously and fail closed (Denied) when no decision exists.
Downloads stage into a confined staging directory and reject directory traversal, UNC/device, and symlink escapes.

T-019.Title: Implement renderer crash containment, provider crash restart and host restart recovery

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Renderer crash terminates the specific page while provider remains alive; provider crash restarts with fresh RuntimeId and revokes old handles.
Host restart restores persistent ContextId, PageId, URL and navigation checkpoints from installation state.

T-020.Title: Implement revision safety across recovery and pre-crash ElementRef rejection

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Recovery reserves a strictly greater DocumentRevision generation before marking pages ready.
Failpoint tests verify that all pre-crash ElementRefs are rejected after restart.

T-021.Title: Implement payload-free operational telemetry and staged upgrade validation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Provider health exposes startup latency, active page/context counts, crash counts, and engine version without leaking payload, URLs, DOM text or cookies.
Staged upgrade validates a fresh ephemeral profile before atomic switch, without modifying active profiles.

T-022.Title: Implement full headful S2 proving slice acceptance test

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: S2 acceptance runs from a clean host through package installation, broker discovery, native IPC, headful local navigation, event observation, semantic query, action, capture, renderer crash, provider hard-kill, state restore and clean shutdown without orphan processes.

T-023.Title: Integrate BrowserProvider CI suite and GitHub Actions workflow

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Invoke-WorldlineCi exposes -Suite BrowserProvider, and PR/master workflows run one named Browser-Provider Windows job.
The gate fails closed if required components or tests are missing, and is included in Suite All.

T-024.Title: Reconcile GRACE graph and verification projections and ROADMAP for M1.2

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: M-BROWSER-ENGINE-PROVIDER and V-M-BROWSER-ENGINE-PROVIDER are added to graph and verification projections.
ROADMAP marks M1.2 Done and activates M1.3.
All verification commands pass and grace lint reports zero errors.
